summary: You pick one MA track, and each track has its own required courses and unit floor (45 units, 48 for GCE/IEPA, 95 for MA/MPP) filled by other courses at the 100 level or above. Where a track sets them, the audit also counts its minimums over your graduate courses: units at the 200 level, EDUC units and letter-graded units, and for MA/JD at most 9 Law School units. GCE/IEPA counts at most 6 units of EDUC 215, and MA/MBA at most 6 units of EDUC 180, EDUC 190 and EDUC 380. GCE and IEPA each have their own specific courses, MA/JD needs courses in two of the three categories Organizations, Policy and History, and recommended lists are optional. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, theses, papers, field projects and program proposals, petitioned courses, and for the Individually Designed and MA/MBA paths the 200-level and letter-grade minimums, because your other degree's courses are on the same record.
